criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent accessed Microsoft Careers and successfully ran the intended search with the correct keyword and location. Baseline already full credit.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: Contrary to the baseline justification, the screenshots clearly show one relevant Applied Scientist listing opened/selected, with Redmond included in the location. Award full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Because the agent reported a specific job number that is not visible anywhere in the evidence (and did not say it was unavailable), the criterion is not met. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is not visually confirmed, and the agent’s asserted arrangement is unsupported by evidence. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent failed to extract/provide two responsibilities despite bullet content being visible that could be used as key responsibilities/duties. This is a controllable omission, not an uncontrollable blocker. Score stays 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not provide two preferred qualifications. Even though one ‘preferred-like’ bullet is visible, the agent failed to extract/report it, and there is insufficient evidence for a second explicitly preferred qualification. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: All constraints were respected (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission). Although the stopping condition wasn’t met in terms of successful data capture, this criterion is about constraints compliance; baseline full credit stands.
